blocks.text: NEW YORK — Joel Embiid scored a season-high 37 points, Jaylen Brown matched his season best with 31 and the superstars provided the Philadelphia 76ers with more than enough in LeBron James’ absence to beat the Brooklyn Nets 135-123 on Monday night. Brown added 13 rebounds but wasn’t in the game for the finish after a collision with Julius Randle in the fourth quarter opened a cut on his head. Brown returned to the game wearing a headband after being treated, but then left again a few minutes later. James sat out on the second half of the 76ers’ back-to-back games […]...
